sources.title: Holy See
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs of the Republic of Serbia
sources.officialityEvidence: The live Serbian Foreign Ministry country page was replayed over normal trusted HTTPS and directly states the visa regime for holders of Serbian national passports visiting the Holy See.
sources.supportingExcerpt: A visa is not required for stays of up to 90 days in a 180-day period

sources.title: Countries whose nationals are exempt from the requirement of short-stay visas
sources.publisher: Ministry of Foreign Affairs and International Cooperation of Italy
sources.officialityEvidence: Italy's live Foreign Ministry schedule directly limits Serbia's short-stay waiver to biometric passports and excludes passports issued by the Serbian Coordination Directorate.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Serbian citizens holding passports issued by the Serbian Coordination Directorate ... are excluded from the visa waiver.

sources.title: Regulation (EU) 2018/1806, consolidated 30 December 2025
sources.officialityEvidence: The in-force consolidated Schengen visa-list Regulation makes Serbia's Annex II waiver biometric-passport-specific and excludes Coordination Directorate passports.
sources.supportingExcerpt: The exemption from the visa requirement shall apply only to holders of biometric passports.

sources.title: Travel documents: Coordination Directorate passports
sources.publisher: Consulate General of the Republic of Serbia in Banja Luka, Ministry of Foreign Affairs
sources.officialityEvidence: Serbia's current official consular page confirms that the Coordination Directorate still issues passports and that its passports do not receive the visa-free regime.
sources.supportingExcerpt: Za pasoše koje izdaje Koordinaciona uprava ne važi bezvizni režim.

unresolved.reason: Ordinary public access to Vatican City uses the Italian/Schengen route. Current Italian and EU rules waive that visa only for biometric Serbian passports and expressly exclude Coordination Directorate passports, while Serbia still issues that document cohort. One passport-wide status would hide a material current split.
